text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
choice_data_list: Haven't you been able to sleep?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mmm.
I was up a little late watching TV~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever seen those?
Those TV shopping shows that are scripted like dramas.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"'Collapsing right during a busy time at work!
Cue the health drink♪' ...Something like that!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, talk about plot armor~.
Or so I think, but that's what makes it so addictive.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~... Come to think of it,
wasn't there a futon that lets you sleep really well, too...?

And so, Nice Nature fell
hook, line, and sinker
for a late-night infomercial...
